description: This file declares structures and functions for managing packed references within a Git repository, including locking, unlocking, size retrieval, and transaction management for packed refs.

methods.name: packed_ref_store_init
methods.description: Initializes a ref_store for packed refs in a given repository.

methods.name: packed_refs_lock
methods.description: Locks the packed-refs file for writing.

methods.name: packed_refs_is_locked
methods.description: Checks if the packed-refs file is currently locked.

methods.name: packed_refs_size
methods.description: Returns the size of the packed-refs file, or 0 if none exists.

methods.name: is_packed_transaction_needed
methods.description: Determines whether a transaction on packed refs needs to be performed.
